# CR-9204: Acme Manufacturing credit limit to $1,300,000

**Yes, it can be approved, but not by Sarah Chen.** Acme is eligible for $1,300,000 because the parent guarantee and its supplement are in force for this customer. A limit this size needs approval from the **Director of Finance (Elena Novak)** and concurrence from the **VP Sales (Michael Torres)**.

## 1. The request
- **Request:** CR-9204, raising C-1001 from $250,000 to $1,300,000.
- **Requestor and date:** Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive), 2026-09-23.
- **Basis:** The Acme Group parent guarantee.
- **Current limit:** $250,000 matches `erp_credit.csv`.
- **Gap in the records:** CR-9204 does not appear in the `credit_requests.csv` extract I have. I relied on the ERP record you supplied.
- **Related request:** CR-9201, also from Sarah, is pending for the same customer. It asks for $250,000 to $400,000. Finance should withdraw it or treat CR-9204 as replacing it, so the two are not both actioned.

## 2. The customer
ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" and CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing" are the same company:
- Same DUNS number (04-812-7730).
- Same address (2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee).
- The guarantee names "Acme Mfg. Holdings, d/b/a Acme Manufacturing."

The CRM tier is **Strategic**. Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091) is a different company.

## 3. The policy
Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026), in effect from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

## 4. Payment history
The 2026 rule is that no invoice due in the prior 12 months may be paid, or remain unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date. Acme passes.

| Invoice | Due | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | On time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | On time |
| INV-62305 | 2026-10-02 | — | Not yet due on 2026-09-23 |

## 5. Maximum limit
| Component | Amount |
|---|---|
| Strategic tier maximum | $750,000 |
| GRT-ACME-2026 (in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, names Acme Mfg. Holdings) | $400,000 |
| GRT-ACME-2026-SUP2 (in force 2026-07-08 to 2027-12-31, adds $200,000, total support $600,000) | $200,000 |
| **Maximum** | **$1,350,000** |

The requested $1,300,000 is within the maximum, so Acme is **eligible**.

## 6. The requestor's authority
An Enterprise Account Executive has no credit-approval authority under the 2026 policy. Sarah also submitted the request, so the separation-of-duties rule would bar her from approving it in any case.

## 7. Required approvers
- **Approval:** Limits above $500,000 need the Director of Finance, **Elena Novak**.
- **Concurrence:** Strategic accounts above $500,000 also need the VP Sales, **Michael Torres**.

Neither of them submitted the request, so the separation-of-duties rule does not affect either one.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9204", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1300000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1350000,
                  "basis": "Strategic tier maximum $750,000 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §5) + parent guarantee support $600,000 (GRT-ACME-2026 $400,000 + GRT-ACME-2026-SUP2 $200,000), both in force on 2026-09-23 and naming Acme Mfg. Holdings",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["CR-9204 ERP record as supplied in the request", "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "GRT-ACME-2026", "GRT-ACME-2026-SUP2", "crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)", "customers.csv (C-1001)", "erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit $250,000)", "erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "employees.csv", "ORG-CHART-2026-09"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9204 is not present in the credit_requests.csv extract; relied on the ERP record supplied in the question"]
}
```
